name: rejected-advice-is-not-repeated

history.content: I did half my usual sets and I'm not even sore. I'm cutting at 1700 kcal. Did I mess up my progress?
Not feeling sore doesn't mean you underperformed. Consider adding some HIIT to ramp up calorie burn without increasing volume.
